factClaims.claim: Initial assault on Wolmi Island began at0633; source says reduction completed0750.
factClaims.quote: The invasion of Inch’on, code-named Operation CHROMITE, began on the morning of 15 September

factClaims.claim: Red and Blue Beach landings took place in the late afternoon; printed times1733 and1732 respectively.
factClaims.quote: Meanwhile, the 1st Marines’ first wave reached Blue Beach at 1732

factClaims.claim: Map legend distinguishes Marine positions on the nights of15 and16September, landing arrows and BHL separately.
By evening Marines reached the prearranged beachhead line, described as six miles inland. This narrative does not license filling either owner mask.
factClaims.quote: By evening they had reached a prearranged beachhead line, six miles inland from the actual landing area.

factClaims.claim: An early declaration of liberation on25September is distinguished from continued control/fighting; do not use declaration as proof of full ownership.
factClaims.quote: Just before midnight on the 25th, he declared Seoul liberated.

factClaims.claim: Naval history explicitly dates capture of Seoul to28September, separate from15September landings.
factClaims.quote: Marine, Army, and South Korean troops captured Seoul on 28 September.

factClaims.claim: Ceremonial return of Seoul is a separate event on29September; suburban firing does not imply the entire city was peaceful.
factClaims.quote: In a brief ceremony on 29 September General MacArthur returned control of Seoul to President Rhee.
